channel.title: yuozas ✦ research
channel.description: Cursed geometry as engineering canon, game-engine heresies, and systems for humans — every claim checkable.

item.title: The Developer's Prism
item.description: The Book of the Two and the Three, read as an engineering text: theorems are directions, proof discipline is the length — and systems that can lie must be constantly re-proven.

item.title: Heresy II: The Blanket Problem
item.description: Engines treat programmer-experience and designer-experience as a zero-sum tug of war. Web development signed a peace treaty twenty years ago. Game engines never did.

item.title: Heresy I: Why I left Unity
item.description: Game engines optimize for the people who can't code — at the expense of their strongest users. A personal archaeology, with commit hashes.
